description: InSight v0.3: kualitas parsing v0.2 (page_label, penggabungan tabel lintas halaman, transparansi embedder, rate-limit & token TTL), arsitektur Dual RAG ketat 2 opsi (HybridRAG & AdaptiveRAG), serta folder resources terpusat.

userStories.title: Add page_label metadata to chunks, Qdrant payload, and chat sources
userStories.description: As a user, I want each chunk to store its source page_label so that chat citations can reference the exact page of the document.
acceptanceCriteria: Add page_label: str = "" field to TextChunk in insight/parser.py and RetrievedChunk in insight/vectorstore.py
Store page_label in Qdrant point payload in LocalVectorStore.upsert_chunks() and return it in LocalVectorStore.search()
Include page_label in each item of sources returned by InSightEngine.ask() and persisted in SQLite sources_json
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Implemented page_label on TextChunk, RetrievedChunk, Qdrant payload, InSightEngine.ask(), and SQLite sources_json.

userStories.title: Extract page numbers during PDF parsing and preserve page_label in chunk_markdown
userStories.description: As a researcher, I want lightweight PDF parsing (pypdfium2) to track page numbers so that chunk_markdown populates page_label accurately.
acceptanceCriteria: Emit consistent page boundary markers in pypdfium2 PDF conversion in insight/parser.py
Update chunk_markdown() to assign single page (e.g. "3") or range (e.g. "3-4") to TextChunk.page_label while keeping "" for non-paginated formats (.txt, .md, .csv, .py)
Add unit tests in tests/test_insight.py verifying single-page and cross-page chunk page_label values
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Consistent <!-- INSIGHT_PAGE:N --> markers emitted for pypdfium2 PDFs.

userStories.title: Merge Markdown tables split across PDF page boundaries
userStories.description: As a user, I want tables split across a page break to be merged into a single Markdown table before chunking so that tabular answers remain complete.
acceptanceCriteria: Detect consecutive Markdown table blocks separated only by a page boundary marker with matching column counts in insight/parser.py
Merge continuation rows into the preceding table without duplicating a repeated header/separator row and preserve the spanned page_label (e.g. "2-3")
Leave separate tables with different column counts or intervening prose untouched
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Implemented _merge_split_tables and row-aware _split_large_table with unit tests.

userStories.title: Expose embedder fallback status in /health and support strict embedder mode
userStories.description: As a developer or user, I want to know when the system falls back to HashingEmbedder instead of silent degradation.
acceptanceCriteria: Add is_fallback_embedder property to LocalVectorStore and embedder_fallback (bool) + embedder_warning (str | None) fields to GET /health in insight/api.py
Add strict_embedder: bool (from INSIGHT_STRICT_EMBEDDER, default false) to Settings in insight/config.py and raise RuntimeError if only HashingEmbedder is available when enabled
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Added is_fallback_embedder, embedder_warning, GET /health fields, INSIGHT_STRICT_EMBEDDER, and tests.

userStories.title: Add login rate-limiting and token TTL to Colab authentication
userStories.description: As a Colab user, I want POST /auth/login to rate-limit failed attempts and expire session tokens after a configurable TTL.
acceptanceCriteria: Add token_ttl_seconds: int (from INSIGHT_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS, default 43200) to Settings in insight/config.py
Track failed POST /auth/login attempts per client IP in insight/api.py and return HTTP 429 after 5 consecutive failures within 60 seconds
Store token expiration timestamps in active_tokens and reject expired tokens with HTTP 401 in require_auth and runtime_disconnect
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Verified rate-limiting, thread-safe active_tokens with TTL expiry and pruning, and passing tests.

userStories.title: Display page citations and embedder fallback warning banner in Web UI
userStories.description: As a Web UI user, I want to see page_label on source cards and a non-blocking warning banner when HashingEmbedder fallback is active.
acceptanceCriteria: Render source page_label (e.g. "Hal. 4") alongside filename and section on chat source cards in insight/static/index.html when non-empty
Display a non-blocking warning banner in insight/static/index.html when GET /health returns embedder_fallback: true
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Verified embedder warning banner and source-page-badge rendering.

userStories.title: Implement Dual RAG engine restricted strictly to HybridRAG and AdaptiveRAG
userStories.description: As a user, I want InSight to support exactly two RAG modes (HybridRAG and AdaptiveRAG) derived from the reference notebooks while keeping local privacy.
acceptanceCriteria: Add RAGMode = Literal["hybrid", "adaptive"], normalize_rag_mode(), and INSIGHT_RAG_MODE setting in insight/config.py
Add BM25Okapi scoring, normalized score fusion, and strategy-aware search ('hybrid_search', 'simple_vector', 'direct_llm', 'comprehensive') to LocalVectorStore.search() in insight/vectorstore.py
Implement QueryAnalyzer, select_adaptive_strategy(), HybridRAG grading + 1x query rewrite, and AdaptiveRAG dynamic weighting + comprehensive escalation in insight/rag.py
Reject any RAG mode outside ('hybrid', 'adaptive') with ValueError
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Implemented in insight/config.py, insight/vectorstore.py, and insight/rag.py.

userStories.title: Expose Dual RAG options and resources tracking in API
userStories.description: As a client or UI consumer, I want /health, /resources, and /chat to expose HybridRAG, AdaptiveRAG, and centralized resources usage.
acceptanceCriteria: Expose rag_mode, available_rag_modes: ["hybrid", "adaptive"], and resources summary in GET /health
Accept optional rag_mode in POST /chat, return rag_mode, retrieval_strategy, and query_analysis, and return HTTP 400 for invalid modes
Expose GET /resources for monitoring downloaded models/caches under INSIGHT_RESOURCES_DIR
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Updated insight/api.py and insight/config.py with resources tracking (100% local).

userStories.title: Add HybridRAG vs AdaptiveRAG selector and strategy badge in Web UI
userStories.description: As a Web UI user, I want to toggle between HybridRAG and AdaptiveRAG in the composer and see which retrieval strategy answered my question.
acceptanceCriteria: Add #rag-mode-select with strictly two options (HybridRAG and AdaptiveRAG) in insight/static/index.html
Persist selection in localStorage, display in Settings modal (#set-rag-mode), and send rag_mode in POST /chat
Render .rag-meta-badge on assistant messages when rag_mode metadata is returned
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Added selector, settings display, and response badge in insight/static/index.html.
